# 服务能力选择

[service-select](../.dependency-service-select/REFERENCE.md) 唯一维护能力选择与 [完整服务契约](../.dependency-service-select/references/mdf/README.md)；本地图像/bridge/ZIP 组装属于 [geometry-input](../.dependency-geometry-input/REFERENCE.md)，其 [函数契约](../.dependency-geometry-input/references/geometry-contract.md) 单独维护。网络调用使用 [hi3d-api](hi3d-api.md) 与 [mdf-call](mdf-call.md)。
